responseMessageContents.text:
The user is unhappy that the mountain detail screen is using generic/reused mountain photos instead of actual photos specific to each mountain. They previously discussed using real mountain imagery, and I apparently said I could find the images. Let me check what's currently in the codebase to understand the situation.

The user said "don't do anything" so I should just explain/acknowledge and propose a plan.

You're right, I apologize for the disconnect. What's currently in the app are generic stock mountain photos being reused across different mountains, which obviously doesn't look good.

For actual mountain-specific photos, the best approach would be to use real photographs of each mountain. I can source these from Unsplash or Wikipedia Commons — most of the well-known mountains (Everest, K2, Denali, Kilimanjaro, etc.) have high-quality photos available with direct URLs.

I'd update the `mountainImages.ts` file to map each mountain to its own unique, real photograph URL instead of cycling through a small set of generic images.

Want me to go ahead and find real photos for each mountain and update the mappings?
